svg.aria-label: Jump resonance of a hard-spring Duffing oscillator: on the upper branch the amplitude rises with frequency until point 2, then drops to point 3; on the way down it follows the lower branch to point 5 and jumps up to point 6. The dashed middle branch is unstable
